prompt: Write a police officer's crash report narrative (about 120 words). Collision type: low-speed head-on collision in Katy, Texas. The claimant was a driver and reported concussion. Refer to people as Driver 1, Driver 2 or Passenger. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1023; do not mention it.)
text: Officer narrative. On arrival at the scene in Katy, Texas, I observed two passenger vehicles in a head-on collision in the northbound lanes of the roadway. Driver 1 was seated in the driver's seat of the first vehicle and stated that the other vehicle crossed the center line while traveling at a low rate of speed. Driver 2 stated that they were attempting to avoid debris in the roadway. Airbag deployment was observed in the first vehicle only. Both vehicles sustained front-end damage consistent with a low-speed impact, and both were driven from the roadway by a tow operator. A Passenger in the second vehicle was seated in the rear and reported no injuries. Driver 1 reported dizziness and a headache following the impact and stated that they struck their head against the side window. Driver 1 said they experienced brief confusion and was advised to seek medical evaluation. Driver 1 was transported by EMS for further assessment. No citations were issued at the scene pending further investigation.
